T: Midnight margaritas. Chocolate cake for breakfast.
D: Two witch sisters raised by their aunts deal with a family curse on love.
P: Serve the margaritas at midnight when the aunts start dancing.
S: Goat's cheese log rolled in herbs and lemon zest, with honey and crackers
Soft goat's cheese rolled in finely chopped rosemary, thyme, lavender and lemon zest, drizzled with honey and served with crackers.
something to soak up the midnight margaritas

Corn chips layered with black beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked bubbling and topped with lime guacamole, sour cream and fresh tomato salsa. Layer 300g corn chips in a baking dish with a drained 400g tin black beans, 200g grated cheddar and 40g pickled jalapeños. Bake at 200C for 8 to 10 minutes until melted. Mash 2 avocados with lime juice and salt. Dice 2 tomatoes with half a red onion, coriander and lime. Top the nachos with the guacamole, salsa and 150g sour cream.
M: Lemon, garlic and rosemary roast chicken with potatoes, carrots and gravy
Chicken stuffed with lemon, garlic and herbs, roasted at 200C for 75 minutes, rested, with roast vegetables and a lemon gravy.
Owens house roast pumpkin and sage soup
a pot always going in the aunts' kitchen

Roast pumpkin and garlic blended silky with stock and cream, topped with crisp sage brown butter, toasted pepitas and warm sourdough. Toss 1.5kg peeled pumpkin chunks and 1 garlic bulb, halved, with oil and salt and roast at 200C for 40 minutes. Squeeze out the garlic and blend with the pumpkin, 1 litre chicken stock and 100ml cream until smooth, then heat through. Fry 12 sage leaves in 40g butter until crisp and the butter browns. Toast 40g pepitas. Serve topped with sage butter and pepitas, with sourdough.
W: Chocolate buttermilk cake with chocolate frosting
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs, sugar and buttermilk, flour folded in, baked at 170C for 35 minutes, chocolate fudge frosting.
Buttery shortbread flavoured with dried lavender
Butter, sugar and flour with dried lavender rubbed in, pressed into a tray, baked at 160C for 25 minutes, dusted with sugar.
K: Tequila, orange liqueur and lime shaken, with a flaky salt rim
45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur, 25ml lime juice, shaken hard with ice, salt rim.

note.text: Midnight margaritas are a family tradition, dear. So is chocolate cake for breakfast.

winks: The curse on the Owens women
The townswomen's coven on the lawn

s.n: Rosemary and sea salt roasted almonds
s.note: Keep rosemary by the gate. Salt over the shoulder.

d.note: Plant lavender for luck. An Owens family rule.

dishes.make_ahead: Roll the cheese in the herbs up to 2 days ahead, wrapped in the fridge; drizzle with honey on the day

steps.text: Chop the rosemary and thyme finely.
Roll the cheese log in the herbs, lavender and lemon zest.
Drizzle with honey and serve with crackers.
Keep a sprig of rosemary on the board for luck.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 5 days in a tin

steps.text: Beat the butter with most of the sugar.
Mix in the flour and the lavender rubbed between your fingers.
Press into a tray and prick.
Bake at 160C.
Dust with sugar and cut while warm.
Cool in the tray.

dishes.make_ahead: Stuff the chicken and cut the vegetables up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; roast on the night

steps.text: Stuff the chicken with half a lemon, garlic and rosemary.
Cut the potatoes and carrots and put them in the tray.
Roast at 200C.
Rest the chicken.
Make a quick gravy from the juices with flour and lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Rub the cauliflower and cut the vegetables up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; roast and make the gravy on the night

steps.text: Rub the cauliflower with 2 tbsp of the oil, lemon zest, crushed garlic and chopped rosemary.
Cut the potatoes and carrots, toss with the remaining oil and put them in the tray around the cauliflower.
Roast at 200C until the cauliflower is golden and tender to the centre.
Rest the cauliflower.
Make a quick gravy from the tray juices with flour, the stock and a squeeze of lemon.
Melt the chocolate with most of the butter.
Whisk in the eggs, sugar and buttermilk.
Fold in the flour and bicarb.
Bake at 170C.
Cool.
Beat the icing sugar with the cocoa and remaining butter and frost.

dishes.make_ahead: Juice the limes up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; rim the glasses and shake each drink to order

steps.text: Juice the limes and rim four glasses with flaky salt.
For each drink, measure 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and the juice of 1 lime into a shaker.
Shake each drink hard with ice.
Strain into the glasses. Best after midnight in the kitchen.

af.make_ahead: Juice the limes up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; shake with the orange juice, agave and ice and top with soda to order

steps.text: Juice the limes and rim four glasses with flaky salt.
For each drink, measure the juice of 1 lime, 30ml orange juice and 2 tsp agave syrup into a shaker.
Shake each drink hard with ice.
Strain into the glasses and top with soda water. Best after midnight in the kitchen.

s.note: Goat's cheese log rolled in herbs and lemon zest, with honey and crackers
s.how: Roll a 250g log of goat's cheese in finely chopped rosemary, thyme, a pinch of dried lavender and lemon zest. Drizzle with honey and serve with crackers. Keep a sprig of rosemary on the board for luck.

m.note: Lemon, garlic and rosemary roast chicken with potatoes, carrots and gravy
m.how: Stuff a 1.8kg chicken with a halved lemon, 4 garlic cloves and rosemary. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes with 800g potatoes and 3 carrots in the tray. Rest, then make a quick gravy from the juices with lemon.

w.note: Chocolate buttermilk cake with chocolate frosting
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 3 eggs, 200g sugar and 200ml buttermilk, then fold in 200g flour and 1 tsp bicarb. Bake at 170C for 35 minutes. Frost with 250g icing sugar beaten with 40g cocoa and 80g butter.

w.note: Buttery shortbread flavoured with dried lavender
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g caster sugar, then mix in 350g flour and 1 tsp dried lavender rubbed between your fingers. Press into a tray, prick and bake at 160C for 25 minutes. Dust with sugar and cut while warm.

d.note: Tequila, orange liqueur and lime shaken, with a flaky salt rim
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml lime juice hard with ice. Strain into a glass rimmed with flaky salt. Makes four. Best after midnight in the kitchen.
